meta.title: Show the Account Assignment Category column to tell assets apart in the list

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab where eligible requisitions are shown.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions list, open the table's manage-columns control, enable Account Assignment Category, close the panel, verify the column appears and shows A for asset lines, K for cost-centre lines, and empty for stock material lines, refresh the page, and verify the column remains enabled with the same values visible.

steps.note: Perform and verify the column selection, line classification values, and persistence after refresh.
Confirm the resulting PR list has no rendering errors or broken values.
